Custom Analytics - Vendor Playbook

Interactive guide for EU vendors · click, explore, try it in Vendor Central · screenshots are examples (names, codes, values hidden)

Take the tour

Pick a screen, then click the numbered markers (or use Next) to see what each part does.

STEP 1

    How to... in under 5 minutes

    Open a card, follow the steps in Vendor Central, tick it in "My checklist".

    1
    Copy a curated dashboard
    ⏱ 1 min
    ▾
    1. Open any dashboard under Amazon Curated.
    2. Click Customise dashboard (top right).
    3. Change tiles, metrics, periods, then Save: it appears under My dashboards.
    2
    Add a metric or dimension
    ⏱ 1 min
    ▾
    1. Click Edit metrics on a tile.
    2. Search (e.g. "return", "country", "model") or browse the Popular tab.
    3. Click + (max 20 per tile); greyed out = not compatible, hover to see why.
    4. Click Apply.
    3
    Compare with last year
    ⏱ 1 min
    ▾
    1. Open Time period(s) on a table.
    2. Pick a preset (T4W, T13W, YTD, a week...) or a custom range.
    3. Add a comparison time period (e.g. same weeks last year).
    4. Read Difference (Absolute) and Difference (%).
    4
    See sales by country of shipment
    ⏱ 2 min
    ▾
    1. Table tile > Edit metrics > search country.
    2. Add Ship To Country Code + Vendor code or ASIN + your metrics.
    3. Apply, then type a country in the column search (e.g. FR).
    5
    Pivot a table
    ⏱ 1 min
    ▾
    1. Drag a column to row groups to group rows (e.g. by brand).
    2. Drag a column to column labels to pivot (e.g. marketplace across).
    3. Use conditional formatting (paint icon) to colour the exceptions.
    6
    Build a dashboard with AI
    ⏱ 2 min
    ▾
    1. Create dashboard or Add Tiles > AI Builder.
    2. Describe: period + comparison + metrics + level + filter.
    3. Check the tiles before you share: AI can make mistakes.
    7
    Share a dashboard
    ⏱ 30 sec
    ▾
    1. Save first: the link shows the last saved version.
    2. Share icon next to the title > Copy shareable link.
    3. Curated dashboards: save your own copy first, then share.
    8
    Prepare a deal event review
    ⏱ 5 min
    ▾
    1. Open Extended Black Friday-Cyber Monday Recap 2026 (or Prime Day 2026 for other events) > Customise.
    2. Set this year's event window vs. last year's.
    3. Add Model Number / ASIN and inventory metrics; save with the event name.

    ✨ AI Builder prompts - copy & paste

    "Show weekly Dispatched Revenue and Glance Views by marketplace for the last 13 weeks vs. last year"
    "Table of my top 20 models by Dispatched Revenue last 4 weeks with Difference % vs. last year"
    "Table of ASINs with Ship To Country Code, Dispatched Units and Customer Returns Quantity, last 4 weeks"
    "Compare Black Friday week this year vs. last year by brand: ordered units, Net ordered GMS, conversion rate"

    Recipe: period + comparison + metrics + level (ASIN / model / brand / country) + filter. Check the result before sharing.

    What do you want to know?

    Pick a business question: you get the exact view to build, step by step.

    READ ANY CHANGE IN 3 DRIVERS

    Revenue changed vs. last year
    ▼ split it into 3 drivers
    1) TRAFFICGlance Views
    Down? Check search (Search query dimensions), content, ads, deals
    2) CONVERSIONConversion rate
    Down? Check availability, price vs. competition, ratings & reviews, sizes in stock
    3) PRICEShipped ASP
    Down? Check discounts, deal share, mix towards cheaper items
    ▼ then find WHERE
    by Marketplace / Ship To Country
    by Model Number / Parent ASIN
    by Category / Brand / Vendor code

    Units = Glance Views x Conversion rate  |  Revenue = Units x ASP

    FAQ

    Use the search box at the top right to filter.

    ?
    How many dashboards can I create?
    ▾

    Unlimited. Each dashboard holds up to 10 tiles; each tile up to 20 metrics and dimensions.

    ?
    Can I change an Amazon curated dashboard?
    ▾

    Not directly: click Customise dashboard to get your own editable copy.

    ?
    How fresh is the data?
    ▾

    Usually 24-48 hours behind depending on the metric; see "Data last updated on" on every tile.

    ?
    How far back can I go?
    ▾

    Up to 2 years for most metrics.

    ?
    Can I export?
    ▾

    Tables to Excel, yes. Charts not yet: use a table with the same metrics.

    ?
    Why does CA show more than Retail Analytics?
    ▾

    CA reads your whole account (all linked vendor codes and marketplaces). Use the ARA vs CA Comparison dashboards.

    ?
    What is the difference between Manufacturing and Sourcing?
    ▾

    Manufacturing = your Brand Registry brands, whoever supplied Amazon. Sourcing = what Amazon bought from your vendor codes, whatever the brand.

    ?
    Which dates does EU data use?
    ▾

    Europe/London time.

    ?
    Can colleagues see my dashboards?
    ▾

    Share the link (Copy shareable link): they see the last saved version if they have Custom Analytics access on the account.

    ?
    Where are metric definitions?
    ▾

    Metric glossary in the left menu: it always prevails.

    ?
    I miss a metric. What can I do?
    ▾

    Click Feedback at the bottom of the page and tell your Amazon team.

    ?
    Is there help inside the tool?
    ▾

    Yes: "Chat with AI" (bottom right) for how-to questions, guided tours, and the User Guide and FAQ in the left menu.
